To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the seidozerites are divided into four subgroups based on the chemical composition and topology of the TS and I blocks, (ii) the TS blocks of seidozerites form a close packing of cation that is independent of the chemical composition and structure topology of the I block and (iii) the I block of seidozerite structures is divided into two groups based on the chemical and structural characteristics.
the TS block is a structural building block that is responsible for close packing of cation in the seidozerites and the TS block is the main building block for the I block.
the seidozerites are a group of closely related minerals that share the same TS block and the same close packing of cation in the TS blocks and in the I blocks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the topology and chemical variability of the seidozrite supergroup and the role of TS blocks in the close packing of the seidozeirite supergroup minerals.
the structural chemistry of the TS block in the seidozerites.
the structural and compositional diversity in the seidozerites, and the close packing of the cations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TS block is the main building unit for the seidozerites and that it is responsible for their close packed cation arrangement and for the close packed arrangement of cations in other structures.
the close packing of the cations in the TS block is a fundamental property of the structure of all seidozerite group minerals.
the TS block is the structural unit that propagates close packing cation layers in the crystal structures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the topology of the TS blocks and the topology and chemical nature of the I blocks are independent of each other, and that the topology of a crystal structure is determined solely by the TS blocks.
the close packing of TS blocks is the main structural feature of all seidozerite minerals.
the close packing of atoms of the TS and I blocks is the main factor that determines topology, symmetry and chemical composition of seidozerite group minerals.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the TS block, the main structural unit of the seidozeirte supergroup minerals, propagates close packing into the I block and that the general topology and chemical composition are independent of the topology of the I block.
the close packing of the cations in the TS block propagates into the I block and that the topology of the I block does not influence the general topology of the seidozeirite supergroup minerals.
the topology of the seidozeirte supergroup minerals is determined by the topology of the TS blocks and not by the topology and chemical compositions of the I block.
